[frontend](fix) drop read/write effects mark on buffer-language alloc (#2165)

* [frontend](fix) drop read/write effects mark on buffer-language alloc

bl.alloc() unconditionally attached an effects = ["write", "read"] mark to
every buffer it allocated, so each alloc carried a synthetic read user even
when it is never written.

PlanMemory derives a buffer's lifetime (gen at first write, kill at last read)
from the real memory effects in the IR, so the bogus read makes it treat an
uninitialized alloc as a live buffer and then report an error because the
buffer has users but no write. Whether a buffer is written is only known to
the caller, so annotate nothing but mem_unique here and let the passes derive
each buffer's effects from the actual stores and loads.

Signed-off-by: jqran <jiaochaoran@huawei.com>

* [frontend](test) cover bl.alloc annotations and a fixpipe buffer end to end

Add a pytest case for the annotations bl.alloc puts on a buffer:

* the TTIR of kernels that call bl.alloc is checked for the annotation
  itself: no mark may carry an "effects" attribute, and is_mem_unique=True
  must still be annotated with mem_unique. The is_mem_unique assertion fails
  on the previous behaviour, where bl.alloc also emitted
  effects = ["write", "read"];
* two end-to-end cases use a bl.allocated UB buffer as the fixpipe destination
  of a tl.dot result and read it back with to_tensor, comparing the result
  against torch on the NPU. They are A5 only, like the other tests that use
  fixpipe.

+    context = ir.context()
+    ir.load_dialects(context)
+    buffer_ir.load_dialects(context)

+    return [

+        if "annotation.mark" in line and "{" in line

+@triton.jit
+def alloc_unused_buffer(x_ptr, y_ptr, XBLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, XBLOCK)
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets)
+    bl.alloc(tl.float32, [XBLOCK], al.ascend_address_space.UB)
+    tl.store(y_ptr + offsets, x * 2.0)
+
+

+    offsets = tl.arange(0, XBLOCK)
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets)
+    bl.alloc(tl.float32, [XBLOCK], al.ascend_address_space.UB, is_mem_unique=True)
+    tl.store(y_ptr + offsets, x + 1.0)
+

+def alloc_ub_as_fixpipe_dst(a_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr):
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, M)[:, None]
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, N)[None, :]
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, K)
+    a = tl.load(a_ptr + offs_m * K + offs_k[None, :])
+    b = tl.load(b_ptr + offs_k[:, None] * N + offs_n)
+    acc = tl.dot(a, b)
+    ub = bl.alloc(tl.float32, [M, N], al.ascend_address_space.UB)
+    al.fixpipe(acc, ub, al.FixpipeDMAMode.NZ2ND, al.FixpipeDualDstMode.NO_DUAL)
+    tl.store(y_ptr + offs_m * N + offs_n, bl.to_tensor(ub))
+
+

+def alloc_unique_ub_as_fixpipe_dst(a_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr, M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr):
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, M)[:, None]
+    offs_n = tl.arange(0, N)[None, :]
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, K)
+    a = tl.load(a_ptr + offs_m * K + offs_k[None, :])
+    b = tl.load(b_ptr + offs_k[:, None] * N + offs_n)
+    acc = tl.dot(a, b)
+    ub = bl.alloc(tl.float32, [M, N], al.ascend_address_space.UB, is_mem_unique=True)
+    al.fixpipe(acc, ub, al.FixpipeDMAMode.NZ2ND, al.FixpipeDualDstMode.NO_DUAL)
+    tl.store(y_ptr + offs_m * N + offs_n, bl.to_tensor(ub))

+def _run_fixpipe_kernel(kernel, m, n, k):
+    """Run kernel on NPU, return (result, expected)."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    a = torch.randn(m, k, dtype=torch.float16, device="npu")
+    b = torch.randn(k, n, dtype=torch.float16, device="npu")
+    y = torch.zeros(m, n, dtype=torch.float32, device="npu")
+
+    kernel[(1, )](a, b, y, M=m, N=n, K=k)
+    torch.npu.synchronize()
+    return y.cpu(), a.cpu().float() @ b.cpu().float()
+

+    max_diff = float((got - expected).abs().max())
